notes.title: Hotfix 11/14
notes.notes: Hey there! This update addresses a few edge cases of content loading and fixes some cosmetic bugs & grammar issues.

notes.title: Update notes for 11/13
notes.notes:
Hey there! Another small patch to address a few issues:

[list]
[*] Reworked the scene loading logic to prevent softlocking the game
[*] Made one puzzle a little bit easier in one of the Hyperdrive levels.
[/list]
Happy gaming!

notes.title: Update notes for 11/11 patch
notes.notes:
Cheers! Here's the first update post-launch. The update fixes several bugs, so do update the game.

[list]
[*] Fixed a code input bug on the restaurant level
[*] Fixed a logic issue on the second ending regarding a puzzle
[*] Fixed an issue with a hotspot on the first nomad level
[*] Fixed an NPC visibility bug on prison level
[*] FIxed an animation issue in the circus level
[/list]

Happy gaming!
